note: Level-wide can-do statements, written for LinguaBloom and aligned with the CEFR levels (not quoted from the CEFR Companion Volume). Unit can-do statements live in the unit files; both are merged when seeding.

statements.en: Can recognise familiar words and very short phrases about people and everyday things, with pictures or help.
statements.zh: 能在图片或提示的帮助下，认出关于人和日常物品的熟悉单词和很短的词组。

statements.en: Can use I, you, he, she, it, we and they in memorised phrases.
statements.zh: 能在熟记的短句里使用 I / you / he / she / it / we / they。

statements.en: Can say familiar greetings and words clearly enough to be understood by a patient listener.
statements.zh: 能把熟悉的问候语和单词说清楚，耐心的听者能听懂。

statements.en: Can write their name, numbers and very simple personal details.
statements.zh: 能写出自己的名字、数字和很简单的个人信息。

statements.en: Can understand short, simple messages and notes about familiar everyday matters.
statements.zh: 能看懂关于日常熟悉事情的简短留言和便条。

statements.en: Can follow slow, clear speech about everyday situations such as shopping.
statements.zh: 能听懂语速慢、清楚的日常场景对话，比如购物。

statements.en: Can order food and drink and ask about prices using simple phrases.
statements.zh: 能用简单的句子点餐点饮料、问价格。

statements.en: Can answer simple questions about themselves, their family and their free time.
statements.zh: 能回答关于自己、家人和空闲时间的简单问题。

statements.en: Can write simple sentences about themselves and their daily life.
statements.zh: 能用简单句写自己和日常生活。

statements.en: Can write a short, simple message or invitation to a friend.
statements.zh: 能给朋友写一条简短的消息或邀请。

statements.en: Can use the present simple, including the he/she/it -s form and frequency words, to talk about routines.
statements.zh: 能用一般现在时（包括第三人称单数 -s 和频率副词）谈论日常习惯。

statements.en: Can use plural nouns, a/an/the and possessives in simple sentences.
statements.zh: 能在简单句里正确使用名词复数、a / an / the 和所有格。

statements.en: Can say what there is and where things are with there is / there are and basic prepositions.
statements.zh: 能用 there is / there are 和基本介词说明有什么、在哪里。

statements.en: Can talk about ability and permission with can and can't.
statements.zh: 能用 can / can't 谈论能力和许可。

statements.en: Can say familiar sentences clearly enough to be understood, though an accent is evident.
statements.zh: 能把熟悉的句子说得让人听懂（有口音没关系）。

statements.en: Can pass on the main points of a very short, simple text in their own simple words.
statements.zh: 能用自己的简单句子转述一段很短的文字的要点。

statements.en: Can understand short everyday texts such as notices, simple stories and personal messages.
statements.zh: 能看懂通知、简单故事和私人消息等日常短文。

statements.en: Can follow short conversations about plans and everyday problems when people speak clearly.
statements.zh: 说话清楚时，能听懂关于计划和日常问题的简短对话。

statements.en: Can describe past events and experiences in simple connected sentences.
statements.zh: 能用连贯的简单句讲述过去的事情和经历。

statements.en: Can give a simple opinion and a reason for it.
statements.zh: 能表达简单的观点并说出理由。

statements.en: Can handle common everyday services, such as checking in at a hotel or asking the way.
statements.zh: 能应对常见的日常服务场景，比如酒店入住、问路。

statements.en: Can write a short connected text about experiences or opinions, using and, but and because.
statements.zh: 能用 and / but / because 写一段连贯的短文，讲经历或观点。

statements.en: Can write a short email to ask for or give simple information.
statements.zh: 能写一封简短的邮件询问或提供简单信息。

statements.en: Can summarise the main points of a short, simple text or conversation.
statements.zh: 能概括一段简短文字或对话的要点。

statements.en: Can repeat and say short sentences clearly, with mostly natural word stress.
statements.zh: 能清楚地复述和说出短句，单词重音大体自然。

statements.en: Can understand the main points and important details of clear texts on familiar topics, such as articles, blog posts and work emails.
statements.zh: 能读懂熟悉话题的清楚文章（如报道、博客、工作邮件）的要点和重要细节。

statements.en: Can understand the main points of clear speech on familiar matters at work, school or in free time.
statements.zh: 能听懂工作、学习或休闲中熟悉话题的清楚讲话的要点。

statements.en: Can read articles and reports on current issues in which writers take a particular point of view, and follow the argument.
statements.zh: 能读懂作者持有特定观点的时事文章和报道，并跟上其论证。

statements.en: Can follow extended speech, interviews and fairly complex lines of argument on reasonably familiar topics.
statements.zh: 能听懂较长的讲话、访谈，以及较熟悉话题上相当复杂的论证。

statements.en: Can understand long, complex factual and argumentative texts, appreciating distinctions of style and the writer's implied attitude.
statements.zh: 能读懂冗长复杂的说明文和议论文，体会文体差别和作者隐含的态度。

statements.en: Can understand lectures and discussions even when they are not clearly structured and relationships are only implied.
statements.zh: 即使讲座和讨论结构不太清晰、关系只是隐含的，也能听懂。

statements.en: Can read with ease virtually any kind of text, including abstract, structurally complex, ironic or highly idiomatic writing.
statements.zh: 能轻松读懂几乎所有类型的文字，包括抽象、结构复杂、带反讽或高度习语化的文本。

statements.en: Can understand any kind of spoken language, including fast natural speech, irony and subtle humour.
statements.zh: 能听懂任何类型的口语，包括语速很快的自然语流、反讽和含蓄的幽默。

statements.en: Can write a short text that gives an opinion and supports it with reasons and examples.
statements.zh: 能写一篇短文表达观点，并用理由和例子支持。

statements.en: Can write a clear email explaining a problem and what they would like to happen.
statements.zh: 能写一封清楚的邮件说明问题和希望怎么解决。
